title: Puns That Carry Weight
text:
A pun is a small machine for producing two meanings from one utterance. When a waiter remarks that the soup is 'a bit of a pickle', the phrase refers both to the dish and to the speaker's unease, so that the diner must hold both readings in mind at once. Such wordplay is often dismissed as trivial, yet it depends on a quick and subtle command of how sounds, spellings and senses fit together.

Writers have exploited this capacity for centuries, using double meanings to deepen a text rather than merely to amuse. A title that resonates both literally and figuratively can prepare the reader for a theme that the story only later makes explicit. For this reason, a pun that fails to translate often loses more than a joke, since the pairing of meanings may be carrying part of the argument.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does the phrase 'a bit of a pickle' refer to?
options: Only the taste of the soup
Both the dish and the speaker's unease

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what can a title that resonates literally and figuratively prepare the reader for?
options: A theme the story only later makes explicit

questions.text: What does the passage imply about the skill that wordplay depends on?
options: It requires no knowledge of language
It depends on a quick and subtle command of how sounds, spellings and senses fit together
It is possessed only by professional comedians
It can be acquired by memorising a dictionary

questions.text: Why might a pun that fails to translate lose more than a joke?
options: Because the pairing of meanings may carry part of the argument
Because readers never enjoy puns in another language
Because the original text was shorter

vocabulary.definition: a joke that exploits two meanings of a word or of similar-sounding words
a spoken word, phrase or sentence
in a non-literal sense, through comparison or metaphor
produces a strong response or echo in the mind of a reader

paragraph_translations: ቃላዊ ቀልድ ከአንድ ንግግር ሁለት ትርጉሞችን የሚፈጥር ትንሽ መሣሪያ ነው። አንድ አስተናጋጅ ሾርባው «ትንሽ ችግር ነው» ሲል፣ ሐረጉ ሁለቱንም ምግቡንና የተናጋሪውን ምቾት አለመሆን ያመለክታል፤ ስለዚህ ተመጋቢው ሁለቱንም ትርጉሞች በአንድ ጊዜ መያዝ አለበት። እንዲህ ያለው የቃላት ጨዋታ ብዙ ጊዜ እንደ ቀላል ይታያል፤ ነገር ግን የቃላትን፣ የአጻጻፍን እና የፍችዎችን አብሮ መስማማት በፈጣንና በጥንቃቄ መረዳት ይጠይቃል።

ጸሐፊዎች ይህንን ችሎታ ለዘመናት ተጠቅመውበታል፤ ድርብ ትርጉምን ጽሑፍን ለማጥለቅ እንጂ ለማስቀው ብቻ አይደለም። በቀጥታም ሆነ በምሳሌነት የሚስማማ ርዕስ ታሪኩ በኋላ በግልጽ የሚያሳየውን ጭብጥ አንባቢውን አስቀድሞ ሊያዘጋጅ ይችላል። ስለዚህ ቃላዊ ቀልድ ወደ ሌላ ቋንቋ ሲተረጎም ካልተላለፈ፣ ጥምረቱ የክርክሩን ክፍል ስለሚሸከም ከቀልድ በላይ ሊያጣ ይችላል።
